q1.sampleAnswer: It’s (on a pole) near an elementary school in Washington, DC.

keyPoints.descZh: 在华盛顿特区一所小学附近（电线杆上）
examples: near an elementary school in Washington, DC

q1.rubricZh: 要点：在华盛顿特区的一所小学附近。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段说电话在华盛顿，第二段说它在小学附近的一根杆子上，把两处合起来回答。

evidence.quote: The phone is on a pole near an elementary school.

keyPoints.descZh: 回答 Yes（可以免费打普通电话）

q2.rubricZh: 要点：回答 Yes, they can.
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说这个电话免费使用，拿起来就能打电话，所以回答 Yes。

evidence.quote: It’s free to use. Just pick up the phone and make a call.

keyPoints.descZh: 他自己录了笑话（把旧付费电话变成讲笑话的机器）

q3.rubricZh: 要点：他自己录制了笑话。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说他在网上买了旧电话，自己录笑话，把它变成了讲笑话的电话。

evidence.quote: turned it into a joke teller by recording jokes himself

keyPoints.descZh: 是 Don Rutledge（电话的创建者）

q4.explanationZh: 按“0#”会连到那个“自以为什么都知道的人”，后面是 Rutledge 自己说他和别人聊天，所以这个人就是他本人。

evidence.quote: Rutledge says he has had some interesting conversations with adults this way

q5.sampleAnswer: Because they are surprised that someone actually answers the phone.

keyPoints.descZh: 没想到真的有人接电话

q5.rubricZh: 要点：他们没想到真的会有人接电话。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段 Rutledge 说孩子们很惊讶，因为居然真有人回答。

evidence.quote: They’re surprised that someone actually answers

q6.sampleAnswer: Yes, I would. I might have a stressful day at school and would like to hear some good jokes to cheer me up. I think a “Jokes Phone” can be very helpful these days. (Answers may vary.)

examples: I would like to hear some good jokes to cheer me up.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先表明态度，再给出理由。
q6.explanationZh: 这是观点题，没有唯一答案。先说想不想要，再说一个理由，比如笑话能让人开心、减轻压力。

evidence.quote: But one old-fashioned payphone in Washington, DC, has become quite popular.
